__comment: NON-GIT VCS ONLY. Merge the `hooks` block below into .claude/settings.json if your project uses SVN, Perforce, Mercurial, etc. instead of git. These hooks REPLACE git worktree behavior, so .worktreeinclude is NOT processed — copy local config files inside the create script instead. Delete this file if you use git.

hooks.command: bash -c 'NAME=$(jq -r .name); DIR="$HOME/.claude/worktrees/$NAME"; svn checkout https://svn.example.com/repo/trunk "$DIR" >&2 && echo "$DIR"'
